function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
好的！我們先用「大五人格」模型（Big Five）來了解你的個性。  
請你根據以下 10 個問題，給出 1 到 5 的評分（1 = 非常不同意，5 = 非常同意）：

| # | 問題 | 評分 |
|---|------|------|
| 1 | 我喜歡嘗試新事物。 |  |
| 2 | 我在社交場合中感到自在。 |  |
| 3 | 我經常關注細節，並且很有組織。 |  |
| 4 | 我容易感到焦慮或緊張。 |  |
| 5 | 我喜歡幫助別人，並且願意付出努力。 |  |
| 6 | 我對自己的情緒控制得很好。 |  |
| 7 | 我喜歡挑戰自己，並且不怕失敗。 |  |
| 8 | 我在工作或學習中能保持高度專注。 |  |
| 9 | 我喜歡與人合作，並且能夠妥善處理衝突。 |  |
|10 | 我對未來充滿希望，並且樂觀。 |  |

請把每個問題的評分填好，並一次性回覆給我（例如：`[4, 3, 5, 2, 4, 5, 3, 4, 4, 5]`）。  
如果你想知道每個人格特質的百分位排名，請告訴我「是」；如果不需要，請告訴我「否」。

等你回覆後，我會幫你計算結果！
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "我是什麼類型的個性？" They want to know their personality type. We can ask them to answer some questions or use the function to calculate big five traits. We need to ask them to provide answers to a set of questions rated 1-5. We can provide a list of questions. Then we can call the function. The function expects answers array and calculate_percentile boolean. We can set average_answers default true. So we need to ask them to answer. We can also ask if they want percentile. So we respond in Chinese, ask them to answer.
